name: Camino | 200mg Fruit Chews | Pineapple Paradise (1:1 THC:CBC)
description: Step into a realm of pure bliss as you wander the serene path of a breathtaking seaside trail. Pineapple Paradise 'Bliss' Camino Chews lead the way with a euphoric blend of THC, CBC, and these plant-based terpenes: Beta-Caryophyllene, Humulene, Limonene, Myrcene, Nerolidol.
